title: Double Integral over Region Bounded by a Parabola and Square Root
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Evaluate iint_D (x + 2y) dA where D is bounded by y = x^2 and y = sqrt(x).

steps.title: Find Intersection Points of Bounding Curves
steps.mathExpression: x^2 = \sqrt{x} \implies x^4 = x \implies x(x^3 - 1) = 0 \implies x = 0, \; x = 1
steps.explanation: The curves intersect at (0, 0) and (1, 1). On [0, 1], sqrt(x) >= x^2.

steps.title: Set Up Type I Iterated Integral
steps.explanation: Inner limits are y = x^2 to y = sqrt(x); outer limits are x = 0 to 1.

steps.title: Evaluate Inner Integral with Respect to y
steps.explanation: Evaluate antiderivative at upper and lower boundaries.

steps.title: Evaluate Outer Integral with Respect to x
